title: System Design
description: System design covering requirements analysis, architecture patterns, scalability, availability, load balancing, caching, databases, Redis, queues, microservices, and API gateways.
learning_outcomes: Analyze system requirements and define architecture
Design scalable and highly available systems
Implement load balancing and caching strategies
Choose appropriate databases (SQL vs NoSQL) for use cases
Design microservices architectures with API gateways
